query: What satisfaction and complaint themes appear in Yelp reviews?

per_column.name: food_quality_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Food quality is a core constitutive aspect of restaurant satisfaction/complaint themes; sentiment on this facet is genuinely 'an aspect of' the concept, not an external predictor.

per_column.name: service_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Service is a distinct constitutive dimension of dining satisfaction and a common complaint theme; it is a part-of the concept.

per_column.name: atmosphere_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Ambiance/atmosphere is a recognized separate aspect of the dining experience and a legitimate facet of satisfaction/complaint themes.

judge.rationale: All three columns are genuine constitutive facets (meronymic aspects) of the satisfaction/complaint concept rather than external predictors, causes, or restatements, so the part-of claim is satisfied. Mutual exclusivity is high: food, service, and atmosphere are conceptually distinct dining dimensions with minimal overlap, though value/price sentiment can occasionally bleed into food or service perception. Exhaustiveness is moderate: the classic food/service/atmosphere triad covers the primary drivers, but salient recurring Yelp themes such as price/value, wait time/speed, and cleanliness/hygiene are not represented, leaving notable constitutive aspects of the concept uncovered.
